tldr: 台積電上修全年美元營收成長至約44%、2026年資本支出上看600–640億美元，AI晶片需求續超供給。
金管會揭六大施政方向、跨業信用資訊交換10月底前上線，高資產與主動式ETF財管業務持續擴張。
美股10/21收高：那指漲約1.05%，SpaceX財報勁揚約10%、傳與特斯拉研議合併；Netflix挫4~5%。
美10年期公債殖利率回落至約5.1%，但油價受波灣情勢撐在百美元附近，總經背景偏緊。

items.title_zh: 台股反彈595點 台積電收2,420元撐盤
items.title_en: Taiwan stocks rebound 595 points as TSMC firms into futures settlement
items.summary_zh: 加權指數10月21日收46,887.77點，上漲594.84點、漲幅1.28%，重新站上46,800點，成交值約8,331億元。盤中一度大漲962點、觸及47,254.93點，尾盤受台指期結算影響，漲幅收斂。台積電收2,420元、漲15元（0.62%），撐住尾盤買盤；櫃買指數勁揚1.94%收395.42點。
items.summary_en: The TAIEX closed up 594.84 points, or 1.28%, at 46,887.77 on Oct 21, reclaiming the 46,800 level on turnover of about NT$833bn. The index had surged as much as 962 points to an intraday high of 47,254.93 before a futures settlement trimmed gains late in the session. TSMC rose NT$15 (0.62%) to NT$2,420 to anchor the tail-end bid, while the OTC index jumped 1.94% to 395.42.

items.title_zh: 逾1,100檔上漲 三大法人翻買超
items.title_en: Broad-based rally lifts nearly 1,100 stocks as institutions turn net buyers
items.summary_zh: 21日反彈格局偏廣，近1,100家個股收紅，資金轉進被動元件與載板族群點火。三大法人合計翻為買超約5.6億元，外資與投信站上買方，但網通晶片廠智邦逆勢重挫。盤面百花齊放，顯示在近期外資賣壓後，低接買盤回流。
items.summary_en: The bounce was notably broad, with close to 1,100 listed names advancing as money rotated into passive-component and IC-substrate plays. The three major institutional investors swung to a combined net buy of around NT$560m, with foreign funds and local investment trusts on the buy side, though networking-chip maker Accton bucked the trend with a sharp fall. The breadth pointed to dip-buying returning after recent foreign-led selling.

items.title_zh: 台積電上修全年展望 AI需求遠超供給
items.title_en: TSMC lifts full-year outlook as AI demand outstrips supply
items.summary_zh: 台積電最新法說會公布第三季營收約1.49兆元，第四季美元營收預估523億至543億美元，全年美元營收成長上修至約44%，2026年資本支出上看600億至640億美元。公司表示AI相關晶片需求持續遠高於自身產能；先進製程A14規劃2027年試產、2028年量產，延續技術領先布局。
items.summary_en: At its latest earnings briefing, TSMC reported third-quarter revenue of about NT$1.49tn and guided fourth-quarter US-dollar revenue to US$52.3–54.3bn, raising its full-year dollar-revenue growth forecast to roughly 44% and setting 2026 capex at US$60–64bn. Management said demand for AI-related silicon continues to run well ahead of capacity, with the A14 node preparing pilot output in 2027 and volume production targeted for 2028.

items.title_zh: AI伺服器需求續旺 台廠供應鏈迎放量
items.title_en: AI-server demand keeps Taiwan's supply chain humming
items.summary_zh: 法人點名約10檔台廠供應鏈可望受惠新一波AI伺服器放量，Vera Rubin、Trainium 3與TPU v8等次世代平台預計2026年下半年進入量產。緯穎、緯創、鴻海、奇鋐等組裝與零組件廠全面卡位；近期OCP全球高峰會亦聚焦高壓供電、散熱、光互連與ASIC等基建升級議題。
items.summary_en: Analysts flagged around ten Taiwan suppliers set to benefit from a fresh wave of AI-server volume, as next-generation platforms such as Nvidia's Vera Rubin, AWS Trainium 3 and Google's TPU v8 move toward ramp in late 2026. Assemblers and component makers including Wiwynn, Wistron, Hon Hai and Auras are positioned across the build-out, which also drew focus at the recent OCP summit covering high-voltage power, cooling, optical interconnects and ASICs.

items.title_zh: 金管會揭六大施政方向 規劃金融業大語言模型
items.title_en: FSC lays out six policy priorities, plans financial-sector LLM
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆在立院業務報告列出六大施政方向，涵蓋風險監理、市場與公司治理、消費者保護、亞洲資產管理中心、金融科技與永續轉型。金管會規劃2027年第一季發布首版金融業務知識大語言模型（FinLLM），並持續推動虛擬資產保管及銀行存款代幣業務試辦。
items.summary_en: Financial Supervisory Commission chair Peng Chin-lung set out six policy directions in a legislative report, spanning risk supervision, market and corporate governance, consumer protection, the Asian asset-management hub, fintech and sustainable transition. The regulator plans to release a first version of a finance-knowledge large language model (FinLLM) in the first quarter of 2027 and continues trials of virtual-asset custody and bank deposit-token services.

items.title_zh: 金管會：跨業信用資訊交換10月底前上線
items.title_en: Regulator to launch cross-industry credit-data exchange by end-October
items.summary_zh: 金管會表示將督促聯徵中心與證交所強化跨業信用資訊交換機制，預計10月31日前上線，讓銀行掌握客戶整體信用風險，並要求落實授信風險控管。金融體質方面，本國銀行今年第二季底平均資本適足率為15.16%，高於法定最低10.5%門檻，體質穩健。
items.summary_en: The FSC said it is pushing the Joint Credit Information Center and the stock exchange to strengthen cross-industry credit-information sharing, with the mechanism due to go live by Oct 31 so banks can gauge customers' overall credit risk. The commission also urged lenders to tighten loan risk controls; domestic banks' average capital-adequacy ratio stood at 15.16% at the end of the second quarter, comfortably above the 10.5% statutory floor.
items.source_url: https://tw.stock.yahoo.com/news/強化跨業信用資訊交換機制-金管會-10月底前上線-100811802.html

items.title_zh: 金管會研議擴大高資產業務 21家銀行獲准承作
items.title_en: Regulator weighs wider high-asset access as 21 banks win private-wealth licenses
items.summary_zh: 在亞洲資產管理中心政策下，已有21家銀行獲准辦理高資產客戶業務，金管會並研議二大開放：放寬高資產客戶投資境內私募股權（PE）基金，以及開放保單融資。銀行高資產財富管理規模已突破2兆元，主管機關藉此爭取高資產客戶資金與家族傳承規劃留在境內。
items.summary_en: Under the Asian asset-management hub push, 21 banks have been approved to run high-net-worth wealth services, and the FSC is studying two further openings: letting high-asset clients invest in onshore private-equity funds and allowing policy-backed lending against insurance. Bank high-asset assets under management have topped NT$2tn, as regulators court wealthy clients to keep capital and family-succession planning onshore.

items.title_zh: 主動式ETF續吸金 成財富管理核心配置
items.title_en: Active ETFs keep pulling in wealth-management money
items.summary_zh: 台灣主動式ETF已擴張至約28檔、合計規模逼近5,000億元，是本地基金市場成長最快的產品線之一，也逐漸成為財富管理核心持有。高資產客群調查顯示，股票與ETF、債券型商品是優先增持的前兩大標的，凸顯包裝化、主動管理型工具正重塑境內資產配置結構。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's active-ETF segment has expanded to about 28 funds with combined assets nearing NT$500bn, one of the fastest-growing product lines in the local fund market and an increasingly core wealth-management holding. Survey data on high-net-worth clients show equities/ETFs and bond products topping their priority lists for added exposure, underscoring how packaged, actively managed vehicles are reshaping onshore portfolio allocation.
items.source_url: https://www.sinotrade.com.tw/richclub/hotstock/主動式-ETF-元年屆滿週年-28-檔規模即將衝破-5-000億-00403A-募資狂飆-800-億改寫紀錄-69f02d3e828d0b0ade35ce79

items.title_zh: 擬制遺產課稅方式三讀 財政部規劃後續稽徵
items.title_en: Estate-tax "deemed-asset" rules advance as finance ministry preps enforcement
items.summary_zh: 立法院三讀通過擬制遺產課稅方式的修正，財政部正規劃後續稽徵作業。此舉牽動特定財產移轉計入課稅遺產的認定，對年底傳承規劃與高資產家庭影響較大；相關施行時點與細節仍待財政部進一步公告，建議及早檢視贈與與保單等安排。
items.summary_en: Lawmakers passed on third reading a change to how "deemed" estate assets are taxed, and the Ministry of Finance is drawing up the follow-up assessment and collection procedures. The move tightens how certain transfers are counted into a taxable estate — a point year-end succession planners and high-net-worth families should watch as the implementation timeline and details are finalized.

items.title_zh: 房地合一稅放寬特定股權交易 即日適用
items.title_en: Finance ministry eases capital-gains rule on certain property-linked share deals
items.summary_zh: 財政部修正房地合一所得稅申報作業要點，放寬特定股權交易的課稅認定並即時生效，對尚未核課或尚未核課確定的案件均可適用。依財政部說明，若股權於2021年6月30日以前取得、其中部分房地屬2015年12月31日以前取得，出售獲利可按該等房地比例享有豁免，有助釐清相關交易的稅務成本。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance revised its filing guidelines for the consolidated housing-and-land capital-gains tax, relaxing treatment of specific equity transactions with immediate effect and applying it to cases not yet assessed or not yet finalized. Where shares were acquired before mid-2021 and part of the underlying property dates to end-2015 or earlier, a proportional exemption can apply to sale gains, helping clarify the tax cost of such deals.

items.title_zh: 央行連10季維持利率2% 貨幣操作偏緊
items.title_en: Central bank holds rates for a 10th straight quarter, leans tighter
items.summary_zh: 中央銀行9月理監事會維持政策利率2%不變，已連續10季按兵不動；總裁楊金龍表示貨幣操作仍朝緊縮方向移動。央行將2026年CPI年增率預估上修至略高於2%的警戒線，反映服務類通膨偏高，惟AI帶動出口使整體經濟動能維持強勁，市場聚焦後續升息與緊縮訊號。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank kept its benchmark policy rate at 2% at its September board meeting, extending an on-hold stretch to ten consecutive quarters, while governor Yang Chin-long signaled that monetary operations are still being nudged in a tightening direction. The bank raised its 2026 CPI forecast to just above the 2% watch line, citing sticky services inflation even as AI-driven exports power growth.

items.title_zh: AI出口撐成長動能 央行年底前續觀望
items.title_en: Strong AI-led exports keep growth outlook firm into year-end
items.summary_zh: 法人預期央行在12月理監事會前將維持數據導向，一方面AI帶動的出口動能強勁，另一方面通膨仍在2%門檻附近徘徊。政策利率按兵不動、操作偏緊之下，市場轉而關注後續物價數據與正常化步調，將牽動股市與房市的資金成本與投資情緒。
items.summary_en: Economists expect the central bank to stay data-dependent through its December board meeting, weighing resilient AI-driven export momentum against inflation still hovering around the 2% threshold. With the policy rate unchanged and operations tilted tighter, attention turns to upcoming price data and the pace of any further normalization, which will shape funding costs for equities and the property market alike.

items.title_zh: 台媒：費半與台積電ADR法說後震盪
items.title_en: Taiwan media: chip stocks and TSMC ADR stay choppy after earnings
items.summary_zh: 台灣財經媒體報導，美國晶片股近期持續承壓，費城半導體指數一度連番收黑，台積電ADR即使在亮眼法說會後仍走弱，市場擔憂AI資本支出與記憶體供應過剩；道瓊則相對強勢，反映資金自高評價晶片股轉向較廣泛的景氣循環股。（部分為近期而非當日內容）
items.summary_en: Taiwanese financial media reported US chip stocks under pressure in recent sessions, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index logging a long losing streak and TSMC's ADR slipping even after an upbeat earnings call, as investors fretted over AI capex and memory oversupply. The Dow, by contrast, pushed higher, underscoring rotation out of richly valued chip names into broader cyclicals. (Reflects recent, not same-day, coverage.)

items.title_zh: 台媒：市場續押聯準會2026再寬鬆
items.title_en: Taiwan media: markets still price further Fed easing into 2026
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，華爾街在聯準會近期降息後，持續押注2026年還有進一步寬鬆空間，即使期間不時出現AI泡沫疑慮與政策不確定性，仍支撐風險偏好。分析指出，通膨數據降溫與科技大廠財報穩健，是美股得以從盤中急跌中反彈的主因。（部分為近期而非當日內容）
items.summary_en: Local coverage noted Wall Street continues to bet on additional Federal Reserve rate cuts into 2026 after the central bank's recent easing, supporting risk appetite even amid episodic AI-bubble jitters and policy uncertainty. Analysts cited cooling inflation prints and resilient big-tech earnings as reasons equity indexes have recovered from sharp intraweek pullbacks. (Reflects recent, not same-day, coverage.)

items.title_zh: 美股10/21收高 SpaceX勁揚、Netflix重挫（2026-10-21）
items.title_en: Wall Street rises Oct 21 as SpaceX surges and Netflix sinks (2026-10-21)
items.summary_zh: 美股10月21日收高，那斯達克綜合指數漲約1.05%、約收26,703點，AI科技買盤回流；道瓊漲約0.7%、標普500漲約0.6%。盤面由SpaceX領漲、Netflix下挫，半導體股翻紅。惟上漲家數不多、小型股僅微幅收紅，投資人靜待大型科技股密集財報。
items.summary_en: US stocks closed higher on Oct 21, with the Nasdaq Composite up about 1.05% to around 26,703 as an AI-led tech bid returned; the Dow added roughly 0.7% and the S&P 500 about 0.6%. Gains were led by SpaceX while Netflix slid, and semiconductors reversed higher. Market breadth was narrow, with small caps barely positive ahead of a heavy big-tech earnings slate.

items.title_zh: SpaceX財報勁揚約10% 馬斯克拋特斯拉合併議題（2026-10-21）
items.title_en: SpaceX jumps ~10% on earnings; Musk floats Tesla merger (2026-10-21)
items.summary_zh: SpaceX公布優於預期的夏季獲利後股價大漲約10%，帶動那斯達克100指數走高，AI交易買氣回溫。執行長馬斯克並表示，SpaceX已朝研議與特斯拉可能合併跨出一步，引發兩檔股票的市場想像；特斯拉則將於當日盤後公布財報，受市場高度關注。
items.summary_en: SpaceX shares leaped about 10% after the company reported a stronger-than-expected summer profit, helping lift the Nasdaq 100 as the AI trade regained momentum. Chief executive Elon Musk added to the move by saying SpaceX had taken a step toward considering a possible merger with Tesla, fueling speculation across both stocks ahead of Tesla's own results due after the close.

items.title_zh: Netflix財報優於預期仍挫4~5% 財測欠佳（2026-10-21）
items.title_en: Netflix slides ~4–5% despite earnings beat as guidance disappoints (2026-10-21)
items.summary_zh: Netflix即便調整後每股盈餘優於預期（約0.87美元、優於預估0.82美元），仍下跌約4~5%，主因第四季營收展望略低於市場共識。法人轉趨保守，Needham將評等降至「中立」、摩根大通調降目標價，使這檔串流龍頭成為科技股走強下的明顯落後者。
items.summary_en: Netflix fell roughly 4–5% even after beating on adjusted EPS (about 87 cents versus 82 cents expected), as fourth-quarter revenue guidance landed just shy of consensus. Analysts turned cautious, with Needham downgrading the stock to Hold and JPMorgan trimming its price target, leaving the streaming heavyweight a notable laggard on an otherwise firmer tech tape.

items.title_zh: 美債殖利率回落 油價受波灣情勢撐在百美元附近（2026-10-21）
items.title_en: Treasury yields cool but oil stays near $100 on Gulf tensions (2026-10-21)
items.summary_zh: 美國10年期公債殖利率回落至約5.1%，但仍遠高於衝突前水準；國際油價在沙烏地阿拉伯與波灣航運再傳攻擊後供給疑慮猶存，每桶徘徊在100美元附近，黃金約4,140美元。投資人在大型科技股密集財報前保持觀望，即使科技買盤回溫，指數漲幅仍相對溫和。
items.summary_en: The 10-year US Treasury yield eased to around 5.1% yet remained far above pre-conflict levels, while crude oil hovered near US$100 a barrel after fresh attacks on Saudi Arabia and Gulf shipping kept supply fears alive; gold traded around US$4,140. Investors stayed cautious ahead of a wave of big-tech earnings, keeping index moves modest despite the tech-led bid.
